answer: Since you financed through Bayline Credit Union, we sent the title paperwork to them, and they hold the title (or electronic title record) until the loan is paid off. You don't need the title in hand to sell the car to us, because at the appointment we confirm what you owe and pay the lender directly from your offer. A payoff letter isn't strictly required, but getting one before you come in speeds things up; ask for a 15-day payoff amount, or sign form NW-LPA-1 and we'll request it for you (allow 2 business days). If your lender is in our e-payoff network, you don't need a letter at all.
